# Load packages

```{r, include=FALSE}
library(Seurat)
library(SeuratWrappers)
library(tidyverse)
library(Biobase)
library(BiocGenerics)
library(ggplot2)
library(gridExtra)
library(AnnotationDbi)
library(org.Hs.eg.db)
library(msigdbr)
library(clusterProfiler)
library(circlize)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(CellChat)
library(UCell)
```



# Load data

```{r, include=FALSE}
load("C:/Users/nwb_l/Documents/r_projects/scIntegration/dataset_processing/muscle/Pryce_PDAC_processed.RData")

pdac_muscle <- PDAC_combined

rm(DEGs_PDAC_clusters, DEGs_PDAC_MuSCs, DEGs_PDAC_Myonuclei, DEGs_PDAC_Endothelial_cells, DEGs_PDAC_vSMCs_pericytes, DEGs_PDAC_FAPs, DEGs_PDAC_Platelets, DEGs_PDAC_Mast_cells, DEGs_PDAC_Monocytes_macrophages, DEGs_PDAC_Neutrophils, DEGs_PDAC_T_NK_cells, PDAC_MuSCs, PDAC_Myonuclei, PDAC_Endothelial_cells, PDAC_vSMCs_pericytes, PDAC_FAPs, PDAC_Platelets, PDAC_Mast_cells, PDAC_Monocytes_macrophages, PDAC_Neutrophils, PDAC_T_NK_cells, PDAC_CTL, PDAC_WS, PDAC_cac, PDAC_combined, cluster_ids, cluster_labels, cluster_to_cell_type, PDAC_cell_counts_cluster)



load("C:/Users/nwb_l/Documents/r_projects/scIntegration/dataset_processing/tumours/PDAC_tumours_scRNAseq.RData")

pdac_tumour <- pdac_tumours_combined

rm(pdac_tumours_combined)
```



# Read in the list of receptors that match ligands from bulkRNAseq of LLC tumours

```{r, include=FALSE}
pdac_receptors <- read.csv("C:/Users/nwb_l/Documents/r_projects/scIntegration/tumour_bulk_RNAseq/receptor_lists/PDAC_secreted_genes_receptors.csv", header = FALSE)

pdac_receptors <- pdac_receptors[[1]]
```


## Check to see which genes are not present in pdac_muscle and remove from pdac_receptors

```{r}
pdac_receptors_use <- intersect(pdac_receptors, rownames(pdac_muscle))

not_in_model <- setdiff(pdac_receptors, rownames(pdac_muscle))

not_in_model

rm(not_in_model, pdac_receptors)
```



# Run GO terms on all receptors picking up signals from tumours

```{r, include=FALSE}
pdac_receptors_go <- enrichGO(gene = pdac_receptors_use, OrgDb = "org.Hs.eg.db", keyType = "SYMBOL", ont = "BP")
```

```{r, include=FALSE}
write.csv(pdac_receptors_go, file = "pdac_receptors_go.csv", row.names = TRUE)
```


## Visualize top 10 GO terms

```{r}
pdac_receptors_go_top10 <- pdac_receptors_go[1:10, ]

ggplot(pdac_receptors_go_top10, aes(x = FoldEnrichment, 
                           y = reorder(Description, FoldEnrichment),
                           size = Count, 
                           color = p.adjust)) +
  geom_point() +
  scale_color_gradient(low = "blue", high = "red", name = "adj. p-value") +
  labs(x = "Fold Enrichment", y = NULL, 
       title = "UP GO PDAC muscle receptors") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.line = element_line(color = "black"),
    axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black")
  )
```



# Run KEGG pathway analysis on the receptors that are upregulated in cachectic muscle

### Get DEGs in cachectic muscle

```{r, include=FALSE}
Idents(pdac_muscle) <- "orig.ident"

DEGs_pdac_receptors <- FindMarkers(pdac_muscle, ident.1 = "PDAC_cachectic", ident.2 = c("PDAC_CTL", "PDAC_WS"), logfc.threshold = 0, min.pct = 0.10, verbose = FALSE)
```

### Subset DEG for p_val_adj < 0.05 and avg_log2FC > 0.2 and in pdac_receptors_use

```{r}
DEGs_pdac_receptors <- subset(DEGs_pdac_receptors, p_val_adj < 0.05 & avg_log2FC > 0.2)

DEGs_pdac_receptors <- DEGs_pdac_receptors[rownames(DEGs_pdac_receptors) %in% pdac_receptors_use,
]

rownames(DEGs_pdac_receptors)
```

### DON'T BOTHER WITH KEGG PATHWAY BECAUSE THERE ARE ONLY 2 UPREGULATED GENES!



# Remove unused objects

```{r, include=FALSE}
rm(DEGs_pdac_receptors, pdac_receptors_go, pdac_receptors_go_top10)
```



# Score cells for receptor expression

```{r, include=FALSE}
pdac_receptors_score <- AddModuleScore_UCell(pdac_muscle, features = list(pdac_receptors_use), name = "pdac_receptors_score")

means_pdac_receptors_score <- pdac_receptors_score@meta.data %>%
  group_by(seurat_clusters) %>%
  summarise(average_pdac_receptors_score = mean(signature_1pdac_receptors_score, na.rm = TRUE))
```

```{r}
print(means_pdac_receptors_score)
```

```{r}
cluster_colours <- c(
    "MuSCs"                 = "#FF7FBF",
    "Myonuclei"             = "#E00000",
    "Endothelial cells"     = "#FFFF00",
    "vSMCs/pericytes"       = "#A47C16",
    "FAPs"                  = "#7CFC00",
    "Platelets"             = "#D46A6A", 
    "Mast cells"            = "#C85C8C", 
    "Monocytes/macrophages" = "#4FBBFF",
    "Neutrophils"           = "#4169E1",
    "T cells/NK cells"      = "#882DC5")

VlnPlot(pdac_receptors_score, features = "signature_1pdac_receptors_score", group.by = "seurat_clusters", pt.size = 0) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cluster_colours) +
  theme(legend.position = "none", axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "PDAC receptors score", title = NULL) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "solid", color = "black")
```

```{r}
FeaturePlot(
  pdac_receptors_score, features = "signature_1pdac_receptors_score", reduction = "umap") +
  labs(color = "PDAC receptors score") +
  theme(plot.title = element_blank())
```


## See if receptors score is different between conditions

### Subset

```{r, include=FALSE}
Idents(pdac_muscle) <- "orig.ident"

pdac_ctl <- subset(pdac_muscle, idents = "PDAC_CTL")
pdac_ws <- subset(pdac_muscle, idents = "PDAC_WS")
pdac_cac <- subset(pdac_muscle, idents = "PDAC_cachectic")
```

### Score cells for receptor expression

```{r, include=FALSE}
pdac_receptors_ctl_score <- AddModuleScore_UCell(pdac_ctl, features = list(pdac_receptors_use), name = "pdac_receptors_ctl_score")

pdac_receptors_ws_score <- AddModuleScore_UCell(pdac_ws, features = list(pdac_receptors_use), name = "pdac_receptors_ws_score")

pdac_receptors_cac_score <- AddModuleScore_UCell(pdac_cac, features = list(pdac_receptors_use), name = "pdac_receptors_cac_score")



means_pdac_receptors_ctl_score <- pdac_receptors_ctl_score@meta.data %>%
  group_by(seurat_clusters) %>%
  summarise(average_pdac_receptors_ctl_score = mean(signature_1pdac_receptors_ctl_score, na.rm = TRUE))

means_pdac_receptors_ws_score <- pdac_receptors_ws_score@meta.data %>%
  group_by(seurat_clusters) %>%
  summarise(average_pdac_receptors_ws_score = mean(signature_1pdac_receptors_ws_score, na.rm = TRUE))

means_pdac_receptors_cac_score <- pdac_receptors_cac_score@meta.data %>%
  group_by(seurat_clusters) %>%
  summarise(average_pdac_receptors_cac_score = mean(signature_1pdac_receptors_cac_score, na.rm = TRUE))
```

### CTL score

```{r}
print(means_pdac_receptors_ctl_score)
```

### Weight Stable score

```{r}
print(means_pdac_receptors_ws_score)
```

### Cachectic score

```{r}
print(means_pdac_receptors_cac_score)
```


## Remove unused objects

```{r, include=FALSE}
rm(means_pdac_receptors_score, means_pdac_receptors_ctl_score, means_pdac_receptors_ws_score, means_pdac_receptors_cac_score, pdac_receptors_score, pdac_receptors_ctl_score, pdac_receptors_ws_score, pdac_receptors_cac_score)
```



# See which tumour cells are communicating with muscle

### NOTE - pdac_tumour already read in.

## Read in the list of ligands from bulk RNAseq of PDAC tumours

```{r, include=FALSE}
pdac_ligands <- read.csv("C:/Users/nwb_l/Documents/r_projects/scIntegration/tumour_bulk_RNAseq/receptor_lists/PDAC_secreted_genes.csv", header = FALSE)

pdac_ligands <- pdac_ligands[[1]]
```


## Check to see which genes are not present in pdac_tumour and remove from pdac_ligands

```{r}
pdac_ligands_use <- intersect(pdac_ligands, rownames(pdac_tumour))

not_in_model <- setdiff(pdac_ligands, rownames(pdac_tumour))

not_in_model

rm(not_in_model, pdac_ligands)
```


## Score cells for ligands expression

```{r, include=FALSE}
pdac_ligands_score <- AddModuleScore_UCell(pdac_tumour, features = list(pdac_ligands_use), name = "pdac_ligands_score")

means_pdac_ligands_score <- pdac_ligands_score@meta.data %>%
  group_by(seurat_clusters) %>%
  summarise(average_pdac_ligands_score = mean(signature_1pdac_ligands_score, na.rm = TRUE))
```

```{r}
print(means_pdac_ligands_score)
```


```{r}
pdac_tumour_cluster_colours <- c(
    "Pancreatic cells"     = "#E00000",
    "Tumour cells"         = "#C0C0C0",
    "Endothelial cells"    = "#FFFF00",
    "CAFs"                 = "#7CFC00",
    "Platelets"            = "#D46A6A",
    "Mast cells"           = "#C85C8C",
    "Monocytes"            = "#80E5FF",
    "Macrophages"          = "#1E90FF",
    "Neutrophils"          = "#4169E1",
    "B cells"              = "#C9A2FF",
    "Plasma cells"         = "#A06BEF",
    "T cells"              = "#B44CFF",
    "NK cells"             = "#5B0E8A"
)

VlnPlot(pdac_ligands_score, features = "signature_1pdac_ligands_score", group.by = "seurat_clusters", pt.size = 0) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = pdac_tumour_cluster_colours) +
  theme(legend.position = "none", axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "PDAC ligands score", title = NULL) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "solid", color = "black")
```



# What receptor genes are upregulated in cachectic endothelial cells in the muscle?

### Subset for endothelial cells

```{r, include=FALSE}
Idents(pdac_muscle) <- "seurat_clusters"

pdac_ECs <- subset(pdac_muscle, idents = "Endothelial cells")
```

### DEGs in cachectic endothelial cells

```{r, include=FALSE}
Idents(pdac_ECs) <- "orig.ident"

DEGs_pdac_ECs <- FindMarkers(pdac_ECs, ident.1 = "PDAC_cachectic", ident.2 = c("PDAC_CTL", "PDAC_WS"), logfc.threshold = 0, min.pct = 0.10, verbose = FALSE)
```

### Subset DEGs for p_val_adj < 0.05, avg_log2FC > 0.2, included in pdac_receptors_use

```{r}
DEGs_pdac_ECs_from_tumour <- subset(DEGs_pdac_ECs, p_val_adj < 0.05 & avg_log2FC > 0.2)

DEGs_pdac_ECs_from_tumour <- DEGs_pdac_ECs_from_tumour[
    rownames(DEGs_pdac_ECs_from_tumour) %in% pdac_receptors_use,
]

rownames(DEGs_pdac_ECs_from_tumour)
```

### Violin plots

```{r}
VlnPlot(pdac_ECs, features = "EGFR", pt.size = 0) +
  theme(legend.position = "none", axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 1, hjust = 1)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Expression", title = "EGFR")

VlnPlot(pdac_ECs, features = "ERBB4", pt.size = 0) +
  theme(legend.position = "none", axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 1, hjust = 1)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Expression", title = "ERBB4")
```
